name: pthread_mutex_unlock_core

ownership.argument: Composition route for uv_mutex_unlock: call this with the uv mutex, which is a plain pthread_mutex_t on p67.

provenance.source: Release half of the NuttX pthread mutex: takes the semaphore at mutex+8 (sub_C1E6A30), then walks the priority-inheritance holder list from the current TCB and posts the semaphore. One caller, the unlock body at 0xC204F08, which is the address the inlined uv unlock jumps to (see uv_mutex_unlock_inlined).

notes: Composition route for uv_mutex_unlock: call this with the uv mutex, which is a plain pthread_mutex_t on p67.
